answer: Each agent can earn voting weight only after completing a sequence of tasks chosen unpredictably by other agents, with results checked against hidden criteria and a small stake forfeited for failed claims. A lotus task might require carrying a signed signal across a bridge of independent reviewers; one identity cannot cheaply precompute the answers. A sybil attacker must fund and operate many identities, repeat the work, and risk losing stake, while honest agents reuse established reputation.
